# BESTAR METAL

> BESTAR METAL is the brand of Shenzhen Bestar Tek Co. Ltd., a custom manufacturing partner for international B2B customers. It supports custom metal product design (CAD/3D), engineering drawings, prototyping and manufacturing. Factory address: Room 101, Building 5, No. 15 Chaodong Road, Chashan Town, Dongguan City, Guangdong Province, China. Images on the website are illustrative, not photos of specific completed orders.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://bestarmetal.com/): overview and buyer questions
- [Products](https://bestarmetal.com/products.html): five custom product categories
- [Design & Engineering](https://bestarmetal.com/design-engineering.html): from idea or sketch to manufacturable design
- [Manufacturing](https://bestarmetal.com/manufacturing.html): fabrication processes and coordinated surface finishing
- [Industries](https://bestarmetal.com/industries.html): possible applications by industry
- [Prototyping & Custom Manufacturing](https://bestarmetal.com/prototyping.html): feasibility, MOQ, costs and lead time evaluated per project
- [About](https://bestarmetal.com/about.html)
- [Contact](https://bestarmetal.com/contact.html): marketing@bestarmetal.com, WhatsApp +86 134 7614 4359
